translations.web: Oh come, let’s sing to Yahweh. Let’s shout aloud to the rock of our salvation!
translations.bsb: Come, let us sing for joy to the LORD; let us shout to the Rock of our salvation!
translations.kjv: O come, let us sing unto the LORD: let us make a joyful noise to the rock of our salvation.
translations.asv: Oh come, let us sing unto Jehovah; Let us make a joyful noise to the rock of our salvation.
